summary: A singing-robot firmware, an homage to the band 386 DX: a text-to-speech voice sings karaoke and MIDI songs or lyrics typed on the FM-1, backed by keys, bass and drum tracks, with an animated robot face.
features: Voice, Keys, Bass and Drums tracks built from chained phrases
Imports .kar and .mid files through a browser page; 8 song slots
Type lyrics on the device; five vocal registers, Profondo to Soprano
Sixteen punch-in effects in the karaoke room
SLAMJAM mode: a generated poem performed with one of eight bands
Songs up to 128 bars and 512 sung notes
